transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because of some driving issues. I just... I keep planning my days around not having to drive over those high bridges. And if I absolutely can't get around it, I just kind of white-knuckle it the whole way across. That's about it, really.
When you drive over high bridges, do you experience sudden episodes of intense fear or panic, or is it more of a general anxiety about the situation?

I don't know if I'd call it a panic attack or anything like that. But... yeah, as soon as I see the bridge coming up, it hits me. My chest gets tight. My hands get all sweaty on the wheel. I mostly just... I just stare straight ahead. Just lock in and try to make it to the other side.
